camera_ready_directives.description: MANDATORY even on accept. The AC has read the entire rebuttal exchange and tells the Professor exactly which rebuttal-surfaced insights must be folded into the camera-ready manuscript. Empty list is not allowed — if an accept truly required no additions, the AC must still emit at least one directive (e.g., 'tighten the scope statement to explicitly name the boundary condition surfaced by critic X').

directive.description: What the Professor must add / change / sharpen in the camera-ready. Concrete: 'Add explicit footprint-leakage 0.090 ablation result to Method §4.2 with the rebuttal critic's framing of feature-block leakage as a per-deployment risk.'

origin_critic_ids.description: Which critic(s) raised the rebuttal point this directive comes from.

must_appear_in_section.description: Which paper section must carry the addition (e.g., 'abstract', 'method.4.2', 'discussion.scope', 'limitations').

rationale.description: Why this rebuttal point is load-bearing for camera-ready quality, in operator terms.

advisor_message_to_professor.description: Single advisor-voice message the Professor will read first when revising. Synthesises the rebuttal mood. Plain prose, not a directive list.

strongest_supporting_evidence.description: Specific evidence anchors (across reviews) that most strongly supported the decision.

load_bearing_objections.description: Objections that survived rebuttal and must shape the camera-ready scope statement (empty list allowed only on full accept with no surviving objections — rare).

minority_dissent.description: Disagreements between reviewers worth surfacing in the limitations section so the reader sees the room of disagreement.

methodology_assessment.description: Aggregate of every critic's direct_methodology_for_user. The AC reads all reviewer methodology verdicts and synthesizes whether the BODY OF EVIDENCE gives the original problem-asker a usable methodology — not just whether the reshaped claim was proved.

methodology_for_user.description: If provides: state the methodology the user can apply tomorrow. If partial: state what IS usable + what's missing. If absent: state explicitly that the user is still stuck and what the camera-ready must add to fix that.

remaining_gap.description: Any gap left to close, even when aggregate_verdict=provides. Empty string if truly nothing remains.
